pairing_timeout.description:
The device did not enter pairing mode. Click Submit to try again.

### Troubleshooting
1. Check that the device is not connected to the Ooler mobile app.
2. Unplug the device for 5 seconds, then plug it back in.

progress.wait_for_pairing_mode:
To complete setup, put this device in pairing mode.

### How to enter pairing mode
1. Force quit the Ooler mobile app.
2. Press and hold the power button on the device. Release when the Bluetooth icon starts blinking (approximately 5 seconds).

setpoint_override_unfixable.title: {name} was discarding your temperature setting
setpoint_override_unfixable.description:
As of {since}, your **{name}** was discarding the temperature you set and reverting to an older value shortly after it powered off — a firmware fault triggered by letting a deep clean cycle run all the way to completion. Home Assistant tried to correct it automatically several times, but the fix did not hold.

## What to do

On the unit itself, start a deep clean cycle and then **cancel it after about 10 seconds** — do not let it finish. A completed clean is what causes this; a cancelled one clears it.

If the problem keeps happening after that, please report it at the [issue tracker](https://github.com/PostLogical/ooler/issues) and include the device address `{address}`.
